mentions.name: Usefulls (Nomad 23)
mentions.description: Usefulls builds modular furniture-luggage, starting with the Nomad 23: a standard 23 kg checked suitcase that physically converts into a twin-door wardrobe cabinet. Removing the wheels reveals circular bumps on the base that seat into grooves on top of another case, letting multiple units stack into a full-size modular wardrobe. The founders are seeking feedback on the concept, the physical design, and their approach to modular furniture/luggage.
mentions.problem: Moving apartments often means repeatedly buying cheap furniture that gets thrown away; this converts checked-luggage into furniture that travels with you.
mentions.source_excerpt: We decided to build Usefulls ..starting with the Nomad 23, a standard 23 kg checked suitcase that physically converts into a twin-door wardrobe cabinet. When you take the removable wheels off, circular bumps on the base seat into grooves on top of another case, letting you stack them into a full-size modular wardrobe.
